title: New to xDrip
symptom: User is new to xDrip and asks whether sensors will stop working at ten days and if there is a notification, and similarly whether the transmitter will cease to work or if there is an end-of-life notification.
fix: For sensors, they will not stop working after 10 days but will die when battery is out, with no notifications; user should change after 10 days. For transmitter, if using Miaomiao 1/2, you can set the system to alert when battery is less than 20%.
evidence_quote: 1. No it will not stop working after 10 days, it will die when the battery is out and you will not get any notifications about it, but you should as always change to a new after 10 days has passed. 2. It depends, if you have Miaomiao 1/2 you can set the system to alert you when it less than 20% battery left.
